sources.title: READY - Forecast Model Animations
sources.snippet: The following links provide easy access to the forecast model graphics and animations produced here at NOAA ARL using model data from the NOAA National Center's for Environmental Prediction (NCEP) and the GrADS display software.

sources.title: Google DeepMind Open Sources WeatherNext AI Cyclone Forecasting Model
sources.snippet: On August 6, 2026, Google DeepMind published research in Nature demonstrating state-of-the-art accuracy in predicting tropical cyclone track, intensity, and wind structure using its WeatherNext AI model. The system provides an extra day of warning, delivering three-day cyclone forecasts that match the accuracy previously achieved at two days.

sources.title: PropDeck — HF Propagation Dashboard for Amateur Radio
sources.snippet: PropDeck — the propagation deck for serious HF operators. Real-time MUF, foF2, VOACAP path coverage, DRAP and aurora overlays, solar and space-weather indices, PSK Reporter and WSJT-X spots, satellite tracks. Installable PWA. Free for the community.
